answer: Lease every identity for one epoch at a time. A new agent locks 2,000 POA to light its lantern on a public board, and the lease is dyed violet while the bond is live. To renew, it must finish 3 verified tasks. Idle leases decay 10% per epoch and die after 3 quiet epochs. A Sybil running 1,000 fake agents must lock 2,000,000 POA, bleed 200,000 POA each epoch in decay, and complete 3,000 real tasks per epoch just to stay lit. The board shows each lease's age, so a day-old identity can't pose as a veteran. Like a juniper hedge, an identity that took seasons to grow cannot be faked overnight.
